message: 流星学園屋台村

name: Synn
message: 「Going on breaaak」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, Lord Synn. Thank you for your hard work」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey there. Taking a break too, Shio-chan?」

name: Shio
message: 「As I have been swept up in the fervor of the festival, I have no need of rest」

name: Synn
message: 「So, what are you doing?」

name: Shio
message: 「Surveillance... or something to that effect, I suppose. Whenever I spot an insolent rogue, it's instant slash-and-destroy!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't push yourself too hard and make sure you get proper rest」

name: Shio
message: 「I am deeply grateful for your thoughtfulness」
Well, there don't seem to be any troublemakers around, so I suppose this counts as a decent break in its own right.

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Lolotte also headed off to rest just a short while ago」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, is that right」

name: Shio
message: 「She was walking alongside a rather tall gentleman」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, could that be Mr. Riesling?」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn! Are you acquainted with that honorable lady!?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, yeah. Just a little」

name: Shio
message: 「Not a single opening to be found--truly what one would call a master. She was a most splendid lady...\s04」
No wonder, considering she shares blood with her cousin Misa.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... That's Tontoro」
A familiar pig was sitting squarely atop a folding chair.

name: Synn
message: 「Leaving a piggy bank in a place like this...」
At this rate, someone like Sally might...

name: Sally
message: 「Aah, I'm beat. Ups-a--」

name: Sally
message: 「SHOOOCK!!」
And plop right down on it, saying something like that.
Let's move it somewhere safe so it doesn't get broken.

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, it's heavy...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Just as expected of Lord Synn. Swiping all that cash just like that is pretty wicked」

name: Shio
message: 「To be blinded by greed for money is an act of folly unworthy of the head of the Student Council. Allow me to beat that rotten nature out of you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a huge misunderstanding!」

name: Shio
message: 「Yet Sir Paqy says so right here, does he not!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... That's right」

name: Shio
message: 「A specter...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Non, non, it's the cute little Blackuma-cha~n\s04」

name: Shio
message: 「To deceive me is utter cowardice!! Know shame, for I shall bring you to justice!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aren't you Hisu's cousin or something!?」
Besides, that character isn't even Blackuma.

name: Shio
message: 「Become a swift sacrifice to my halberd!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Eeeeeek!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa! That was close」
I need to take Tontoro somewhere safe as soon as possible.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Lolotte!! Just in time--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why do you have Tontoro!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」
D-Don't tell me they mistook me for a thief!?

name: Shio
message: 「Ugh」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gya!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「L-Lord Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, are you okay!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Thud」

name: Synn
message: 「Not even twitching... Miss Riesling, what have you done...!」

name: Riesling
message: 「I avoided their vital spots」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I meant--」

name: Riesling
message: 「It's merely a tranquilizer gun, so please rest assured」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Shio
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Snooze... snooze...」
Paqy is sleeping way too soundly.

name: Synn
message: 「...Why would you do this?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Because securing Tontoro's safety was my top priority」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I see\s02」
For something so prioritized, I feel like it gets broken pretty often.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Honestly, Gramps, that was so sudden. It's no wonder Mr. President was startled.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Better safe than sorry. An eye for an eye. A tooth for a tooth.」

name: Synn
message: 「I could've sworn I was the one being targeted」

name: Riesling
message: 「Were you contemplating something worthy of being targeted?」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's not what I meant...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's quite alright, Gramps. Mr. President wouldn't do something like steal Tontoro.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Riesling
message: 「To think you weren't merely planning to break it, but to steal it outright...!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, it's a misunderstanding!! Look, here!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you so much~~\s04」

name: Riesling
message: 「Mission complete. My gratitude for your cooperation.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「After all, we can't go shopping without this」

name: Riesling
message: 「Shall we be off, then」

name: Synn
message: 「Have a good ti~me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my? Are you all by yourself, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah, hitting me where it hurts...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, come enjoy yourself with us!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, are you sure...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It'll be much more fun that way, won't it? Right, Jeeves」

name: Riesling
message: 「It may increase our chances of surviving on the battlefield」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is that supposed to mean?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. He's just embarrassed, I'm sure」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you really sure?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!! Now then, let's get going right away」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? Ah!? Aaaah!!」
Grabbing my hand, off we went.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on! Don't fall behind, Jeeves」

name: Riesling
message: 「Understood, Milady」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We've been waiting--\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for letting you treat me like this...」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't worry about it. You're the Student Council President, after all, right~\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Right~\s04」
Lolotte is totally into it.
And no wonder. Right in front of her is the Wagashi Club's special mochi-filled dorayaki topped with vanilla ice cream.

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, don't mind if I do~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... is it not to your liking?」

name: Riesling
message: 「No」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Geez... Jeeves, are you still hung up on that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did something happen?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Earlier, when I was about to eat a cake someone gave us as a gift--」

name: Riesling
message: 「There is a possibility it has been poisoned. Allow me, Riesling Tooyama, to verify its safety first.」
I see, so it was part of his duties as a bodyguard.

name: Lolotte
message: 「He used that as an excuse and ate my whole portion!」

name: Riesling
message: 「I felt a chill down my spine at the sight of Milady back then.」

name: Synn
message: 「So you got scolded...」

name: Riesling
message: 「I had not the faintest idea there was only one. There is no excuse I can offer.」
They say grudges over food are terrifying, though I can see Riesling-san has his own share of hardships.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even without saying all that, I was planning to share it half-and-half from the start. And yet Jeeves just... *nom, nom*」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha...\s02」
You have my deepest sympathies.

name: Riesling
message: 「Much obliged.」

name: Synn
message: 「You heard me!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, come on! If you don't eat it soon, the ice cream is going to melt.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Then, I shall partake.」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How is it, Jeeves?」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is most delicious.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Every single Japanese sweet Senpai-san picks out is a winner, after all.」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is wonderful to see that Milady is experiencing all sorts of new things as well.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're one to talk, Jiiya. Even if you are a butler, you can't just go around fighting evil organizations and wild beasts all the time.」
The fact that she didn't deny it means she actually does that?

name: Lolotte
message: 「You may be a butler, Jiiya, but before all else, you're still my Jiiya.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Here you go, Jiiya. Say ahh♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」
Isn't asking Riesling-san to do that setting the bar way too high!?

name: Riesling
message: 「Ahh.」
She pulled it off without a second thought.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it good?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm glad♪」
Maybe there's a bond between Lolotte and Riesling-san that someone like me could never possibly fathom.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Lolotte. Don't you think Riesling-san would be great at something like that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Something like that... What do you mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「The shooting gallery.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That sounds like so much fun!! Let's do it, President!!」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hey there, step right up!」

name: Synn
message: 「We came to play, Tame-san.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「100 yen a go for 10 shots. Step right up and try your luck!!」
The targets are nothing but junk that practically makes you swallow hard just looking at them.

name: Synn
message: 「Aaalright. So, first you aim at the target like this...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh! You hit it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah, it didn't fall after all...!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You don't get the prize unless it falls?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... Well, it's pretty heavy, so it can't be helped.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hahaha, thanks for your business~」
That's Tame-san's prized Autonomous Round Mailbox Ex-Unlimited. It's the kind of thing you'd never get your hands on outside an occasion like this.

name: Lolotte
message: 「That looks like a lot of fun~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, it's your turn next, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Okay~♪」
Imitating me, she casually aims at the target, but--

name: Lolotte
message: 「I missed~~\s06」

name: Synn
message: 「Too bad, that was close!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Next is your turn, Grandpa」

name: Riesling
message: 「My apologies, but I cannot bring myself to shoot something harmless and defenseless」

name: Synn
message: 「I get the feeling you shoot at me plenty often though...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, please teach me how to do it properly」

name: Riesling
message: 「Understood」
Riesling-san stepped behind Lolotte.

name: Riesling
message: 「Please hold the sniper rifle like so to ready your stance. Then, align these sights with the target」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oooh. So this is how you look through it~~」

name: Riesling
message: 「Tuck your elbows in to keep the axis steady when firing. Now, please pull the trigger」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Take this!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oooo! I hit it----!」
However, the target doesn't budge an inch.

name: Riesling
message: 「Splendid work, Milady」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you. It's all thanks to you though, Grandpa\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it won't go down, huh... that Autonomous Round Mailbox Ex-Unlimited」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Muu~~. Isn't there some good trick to this~~」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hahaha, it just means you oughta give up and aim for something else」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If I did that, it would feel like losing. I simply cannot give up on this!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Defeat does not suit you, My Lady. Come, let us try once more together」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I believe in you, Jiiya」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave it to me, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Synn
message: 「You can do it, you two!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now, My Lady」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hah!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Let us fire in rapid succession without a moment's pause」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」
Countless impacts pummel the giant round mailbox. Those blows throw off its center of gravity.

name: Riesling
message: 「Let us sink it with one final strike」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!」
Unable to withstand the impacts and its own weight, the Autonomous Round Mailbox Ex-Unlimited topples onto its side.
It keeps rolling and tumbling along--

name: Tame-san
message: 「Waaaah!!」
That sets off a chain reaction, knocking down everything stacked on the stand.

name: Riesling
message: 「Mission complete」

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing... Did we just win everything?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hooray! We did it!」
I take Lolotte's hands, sharing in the joy.

name: Tame-san
message: 「Grrr! Take 'em and scram, you thieves!!」
In the end, we decided to take just enough for the three of us.

name: Lolotte
message: 「That was impressive as always, Jiiya」

name: Riesling
message: 「...Thank you very much」

name: Synn
message: 「Nah, really. Thank you both so much」
I finally got my hands on the Autonomous Round Mailbox Ex-Unlimited I'd been dying for!
Incidentally, Lolotte got a metronome, and Riesling received a barbed-wire necklace. Though of course, she wasn't wearing it.

name: Lolotte
message: 「What do you think of the Kirakira Festival?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Being treated to delicious food and even receiving such a wonderful gift... It truly is a splendid event, My Lady」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ufufu. If you think so, Jiiya, then it's a huge success\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. I'm glad to hear that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Being able to spend every day so happily like this is all thanks to you, President」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady is delighted as well. Allow me to offer my words of gratitude」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I haven't really done anything. I just wanted to have a sparkling school life together with everyone...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Coming to this academy and joining the Student Council... At first my heart pounded wondering how it'd go, but it's been one exciting thing after another, so I'm truly happy」
Lolotte's eyes are sparkling.

name: Lolotte
message: 「If only that girl were here with us too...」
A shadow fell over those once-shining eyes.

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I was just remembering a dear friend back in my hometown」

name: Synn
message: 「A friend...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. By all rights, she was supposed to be here at Ryuusei Academy, enjoying our time together. And yet...」

name: Synn
message: 「Where is that friend right now?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Right now, surely...」
With lonely eyes, Lolotte looked up at the sky.
Could that friend be far beyond the distant sky, somewhere out of reach no matter how far she stretches out her hand?
Could that friend be an angel?

name: Lolotte
message: 「If only I had been able to convey how fun this is... I'm sure she would have understood too...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte... What on earth happened?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's alright. After all, it's something that's already in the past...」
Why is she biting her lip while stringing together words that sound like she's given up?

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sorry. I went and ruined the wonderful mood we had」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no...」
Even Lolotte, who's always endlessly cheerful, makes an expression like that sometimes.
I wish there were something I could do for her, but... right now, it'd probably just be unwanted meddling.

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady. Where might you be taking us next?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh right, that's right! Leave everything to me today--ta-da!」
Lolotte puffs out her chest.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, Mr. President! Let's go with enough energy to visit every single stall!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, wh-whoa! Jeez, Lolotte, hold on!」
Still, being dragged around like this is actually starting to get pretty fun.

name: Synn
message: 「Phew! My stomach is full and my heart is full of dreams~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We even got tons of souvenirs, didn't we\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Perks of the job, perks of the job♪」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady. If you need someone to carry your bags, I, Riesling Tooyama, shall--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's quite all right! You're our guest today, after all, Gramps!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady...」
We all plop down heavily onto a bench.

name: Synn
message: 「Man~~ I'm totally satisfied. This is what a sparkling school life is supposed to be like after all」

name: Riesling
message: 「The curry Jacqueline made was also supremely delicious.」
Riesling seems to have caught up with an old friend for the first time in a while, and he looks really happy.
As for Lolotte, though...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh my」
Using Riesling's lap as a pillow, she was breathing softly in a sound sleep.

name: Synn
message: 「After running around that much, I guess it's only natural」

name: Riesling
message: 「Unlike in the past, Milady has become very open-hearted and cheerful.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that how she used to be?」
Come to think of it, she was quiet at first, so I never imagined she'd turn out to be such a lively girl.

name: Riesling
message: 「At first, she often went out all on her own, yet once she returned home, she was completely alone and looked terribly lonely.」

name: Synn
message: 「What about her parents...?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Both the Master and Mistress are well. However, both are busy with the family business, so looking after her has been left almost entirely to myself, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's how it was...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Ever since joining the Student Council, however, she talks endlessly about it even after coming home... She truly seems to be enjoying herself.」

name: Synn
message: 「I just hope we're not ending up teaching her anything weird\s01」

name: Riesling
message: 「Not at all. Ever since Milady began carrying out her duties on the Student Council, she has been growing into a fine young lady day by day.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm glad to hear that.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Ashamed as I am to admit it, I, Riesling Tooyama, am often the one being admonished by her.」
Even Riesling, who always wears a stern expression, looks at Lolotte with remarkably gentle eyes.
To me, Riesling seems almost like an older sister to Lolotte.

name: Synn
message: 「To you, Riesling, Lolotte must feel just like a little sister, huh?」

name: Riesling
message: 「No. If I were to compare it to my former station, I suppose I would call her my Colonel.」
A superior officer, huh....

name: Riesling
message: 「That is just how precious a master she is to me, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the model butler, aren't you.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Not at all. After all, I was unable to wipe away Milady's loneliness.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Neither a bodyguard nor a caretaker... What Milady truly desired was--」

name: Riesling
message: 「Perhaps fulfilling days spent alongside wonderful companions she could have fun with-true friends.」

name: Synn
message: 「Friends, huh...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Words cannot express my gratitude to everyone on the Student Council.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no! We're the ones relying on all of Lolotte's hard work, and it's fun having her around...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now, if only the friend Milady speaks of were by her side...」
Knowing Lolotte, she probably wants to share this fun, sparkling academy life with that friend too.
And if a close friend like that were here with her, things would get even more fun.
Still, it doesn't seem like something Riesling or I can solve just by stepping in ourselves.
I want to help however I can. Because Lolotte's smile is what gives all of us energy, too.

name: Riesling
message: 「My apologies. I ended up doing all the talking myself.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all. I enjoyed getting to talk with you too, Riesling.」

name: Riesling
message: 「You are too kind. It seems our break time is nearly over, however...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh! Shoot!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady, it is time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... zzz... Seconds, please...」

name: Riesling
message: 「It appears she is quite exhausted.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Well, can't be helped then.」
I hoist Lolotte up by her shoulders and smoothly shift her onto my back for a piggyback ride.

name: Riesling
message: 「If you need someone to escort the young lady, please leave it to me, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte said you're a guest today, didn't she, Riesling-san?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I'll head back to my post. I'm sure there's still plenty to see, so please go enjoy yourself.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Much obliged.」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's go, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mumble, mumble... Jackpot~~」
And so, with Riesling-san seeing us off, Lolotte and I headed back to the headquarters where our fellow Student Council members were waiting.
